applies_to.quote: Reserve Bank of India (Small Finance Banks - Acquisition and Holding of Shares or Voting Rights) Amendment Directions, 2026

answer.action: Qualifying mutual funds, insurance companies, and pension funds seeking one-time approval for subsequent major shareholdings up to 10% must apply via PRAVAAH and report holding changes within three working days.
answer.action_quote: qualifying persons are required to make an application, through PRAVAAH, to the Reserve Bank along with the declaration in Form A .

effective_date.quote: These Directions shall come into force with immediate effect.

answer.amends: Reserve Bank of India (Small Finance Banks – Acquisition and Holding of Shares or Voting Rights) Directions, 2025
